content.name: Christopher Flournoy
content.title: Restaurant Operations & Multi-Shift General Management Leader

layout_containers.content: High-volume hospitality operations leader with 10+ years directing multi-shift dining, kitchen, and bar operations. Track record managing high-throughput units averaging $140K-$150K weekly gross sales, leading corporate New Store Openings (NSOs), reducing food-cost variance by 18%, and maintaining 94% workforce retention across 65+ personnel with zero critical health or liquor compliance infractions.
